auditor_value: Setup (i): the person pulls with W in (i) and W/2 in (ii) (two strands hold the block's pulley)

findings.note: False equation: the block's pulley is held by TWO strands, as the same step's text says, so the balance is 2T = Mg. The printed 4T = Mg gives T = Mg/4, which contradicts the next line's T(ii) = Mg/2; a student copying this line loses the mark.

findings.quote: (a) Fig. (i) — it needs Mg, twice the Mg/2 needed in Fig. (ii).
findings.note: The served question and its options call the arrangements 'Setup (i)' and 'Setup (ii)'; the solution uses 'Fig (i)/(ii)' throughout, a label the student never sees.
findings.fix: (a) Setup (i) — it needs Mg, twice the Mg/2 needed in Setup (ii).

notes: Independently: setup (i) single strand F = Mg; setup (ii) string tied to the bracket, under the block's pulley, over the fixed pulley: 2T = Mg so F = Mg/2. The final option (a) is correct; the harmful finding is the false middle equation only. Mistake entries point at the right options (2 and 3).
